text.tspan: SEISMIC EVENT
@unhappychoice detonates 2,199 commits on a Wednesday. Seismologists baffled.
BREAKING
@unhappychoice opens 1,024 PRs in 7 days. GitHub servers reportedly weeping.
CRYPTO CHAOS
@unhappychoice verifies TLS certs on bitFlyer WebSockets. Exchange relieved.
RHYTHM GAME DRAMA
@unhappychoice fixes bmson gauge recovery AND adds key remapping. Gamers rejoice.
ANDROID ALERT
@unhappychoice ships Test Results screen to Norimaki in 675 lines. Zero deletions.
MEMORY CRISIS AVERTED
@unhappychoice caps circleci-cli watch logs at 256 KiB. Heap breathes again.
HISTORIC CACHE
@unhappychoice builds 32-slot LRU thumbnail cache in tapline. Pixels reused.
IRASUTOYA EXCLUSIVE
@unhappychoice teaches a CLI to download Japanese clip art. Priorities unclear.
